home_section2.paragraph_1: Our company, located in Miami, specializes in the manufacture of custom carpentry, both locally and imported from Europe. We offer tailor-made solutions that combine quality, design, and functionality, tailored to the needs of architects, designers, builders, and the general public. We also provide carpentry accessories and specialized technical support in drawing and rendering, ensuring the efficient management of each project.

We aim to be the trusted partner of architects, designers, and builders, offering innovation, quality, and efficiency, both with our local carpentry in Miami and our European line.

home_section4.title: Our Process
home_section4.description: At Archiwood, every project begins with a unique idea and a fully personalized approach. Our process is designed to ensure that each piece of carpentry is a masterpiece that reflects your needs and vision. Below are the steps of our process:

options.title: Initial Consultation
options.description: We begin with a meeting with you to understand your vision, needs, and the style you wish to achieve. During this stage, we gather all the key details of the project to ensure our solutions perfectly match your expectations.

options.title: Estimation and Budget
options.description: Based on the initial consultation, we provide you with a detailed estimate and a personalized budget. We ensure the budget is transparent, clear, and tailored to your needs, considering materials, manufacturing time, and installation.

options.title: Custom Design
options.description: Our design team creates customized plans and designs based on your requirements. We use advanced drawing and rendering tools so you can visualize the final design and make any adjustments before proceeding with production.

options.title: Material Selection
options.description: We work with you to choose the most suitable materials for your project, whether with high-quality local wood or our exclusive line imported from Europe. We ensure that the selected materials meet your aesthetic and durability expectations.

options.title: Manufacturing
options.description: Once the design and materials are approved, we begin manufacturing. Our team of expert carpenters brings each piece to life with precision, paying attention to every detail to guarantee the highest quality and finish.

options.title: Installation
options.description: The final step is installation. Our team handles delivery and installation on-site, ensuring everything fits perfectly and meets the highest quality standards.

options.title: Post-Sale Support
options.description: After installation, we remain committed to your satisfaction. We offer post-sale support to address any concerns or additional needs.

items.text_2: From modern, minimalist kitchens to classic, elegant designs, our team transforms your space into a practical and harmonious environment. Discover the difference of a custom-made kitchen with Archiwood.

news.title: Andreina Orta | Creative Talks
news.content:
Andreina Orta from Archidesart is a talented Venezuelan architect and interior designer, with many years of experience working with developers to create stunning spec homes. She spent her early years working in Venezuela in her family’s construction company, as an architect and designer.

Since arriving in Miami, she ventured into carpentry, specializing in this field, which led her to create her own custom furniture company. Archidesart, in addition to developing her own projects, collaborates with other designers and architects to create unique pieces with excellent detail and finishes.

Today we will talk about her next milestone, as she is about to open her boutique carpentry design showroom in Doral.

news.title: Learning Session Millwork with Archidesart
news.content: This day marked a pivotal moment for Collab Girls community of interior designers as we delved into the first workshop of 2024, a captivating exploration into the world of millwork, hosted by @bluebycindy and dictated by Andreina Orta from @archidesart.usa who unveiled the artistry of millwork in a tapestry of design.  The workshop served as a testament to the unity that binds us a creators.  Through collaborative exercises and insightful discussions, we discovered fresh perspectives and approaches to integrating millwork seamlessly into our design narratives.  The air buzzed with creativity and collaboration as passionate designers gathered to unravel the intricate artistry that defines our craft.  A sincerey thank you to Intercoverings for your hospitality and making us feel like home.   Sponsors: Archidesart, Architectural Authority Magazine
